believed_composition: Bornean (Pongo pygmaeus s.s.) + Sumatran (Pongo abelii) + possible captive hybrids, pooled
split_authority: Groves 2001 (Primate Taxonomy); elevation of P. abelii to species
note: Any pre-2001 'Pongo pygmaeus' species mean maps HERE, not to a modern species. A pooled mean over this concept cannot be un-averaged: composition of the underlying sample is usually unrecoverable. Individual specimens under this label may still be resolved (see specimen_crosswalk.resolved_taxon).
Bornean orangutan, narrow modern sense. Three subspecies (P. p. pygmaeus, morio, wurmbii) not tracked separately here.

Sumatran orangutan, elevated from subspecies Pongo pygmaeus abelii. Catalog rows recorded as 'Pongo pygmaeus / subspecies abeli' or '/ sumatra' (CAT-150, CAT-151) and MacLeod YN85-38 ('PONGO PYGMAEUS / ABELII') belong here at the specimen level.

believed_composition: Individually dated Late Pleistocene H. sapiens fossils: Qafzeh 9, Skhul 5, Mladeč 1, Cro-Magnon 1 (Kochiyama EH group, n=4). Each is an identified specimen, so unlike Pongo pygmaeus (s.l.) a group mean here IS decomposable back to named individuals.
note: Same species as living humans but a distinct temporal grade and measurement basis (endocast / MRI-deformed fossils vs living soft-tissue brains). HARD RULE: values under this concept are NEVER pooled into the extant 'Homo sapiens' species mean. Opposite direction to the Pongo hazard: there the risk is promoting a broad mean to a narrow modern species; here it is a fossil grade being absorbed into the living-human mean. modern_equivalent left NA deliberately.

believed_composition: Living modern humans. Referent of a bare 'Homo sapiens' species mean in extant-focused sources: Seymour et al. 2015 (Soligo 2006, n=7), Stephan collection, Zilles, Bush, Rilling & Insel, and the Kochiyama MH sample (living, MRI/MRA soft tissue, n=1185).
note: A value labelled only 'Homo sapiens' DEFAULTS here unless the source is explicitly a fossil source (Kochiyama EH, Weaver A-15). The single pooled 'Homo sapiens' row in volumes_long.csv (Stephan; Zilles; Bush; RillingInsel) belongs here.

believed_composition: Neanderthal fossils: Amud 1, La Chapelle-aux-Saints 1, La Ferrassie 1, Gibraltar 1 / Forbes' Quarry 1 (Kochiyama NT group, n=4). Extinct sister species; each an identified specimen, group mean decomposable.
note: Distinct extinct species (divergence from H. sapiens ~600-800 ka per Kochiyama ref 19). Never merged into any Homo sapiens mean, fossil or extant. Weaver labels these 'Late Archaic Homo' (group 12-LAH).
